integrity: The proof normalizes one complement element and converts all other generators into kernel vectors, reducing generation to finite-field spanning. The exact graph decomposition and degree formulas then follow. A standalone checker reconstructs the smallest nontrivial case directly from generating triples.
scientific_limitations: The complement is assumed to have odd prime order.
The Frobenius kernel is a homogeneous direct sum of one irreducible scalar module.
The theorem settles the degree-divisibility question only for this family.
title: Rank graphs of scalar prime-complement Frobenius groups are multipartite joins
